digest.component_or_area: plan-review verdict dispatch and criteria assembly
propositions: Malformed criteria configuration in assemble-criteria step raises CriteriaError but workflow recorder preserves only undifferentiated exception string, losing typed failure identity

Generic workflow failure tail in produce_plan_review_verdict treats every unrecognized failure as LLM outage and routes to _degraded_plan_review_verdict, which unconditionally sets llm_unavailable=true regardless of actual cause
Plan review returns unsigned INDETERMINATE with false llm_unavailable label and no actionable diagnostic pointing to stale/installed build mismatch

Fix must distinguish CriteriaError at assemble boundary, emit stable structured failure_kind marker, route to dedicated config-fault verdict path preserving deterministic findings without llm_unavailable flag
Config-fault verdict must remain fail-closed INDETERMINATE unless deterministic blocker present, and must name running installed rebar build as suspect with actionable repository checkout remediation
